title: Interval integral bounded by the integral over (-a, a) of an a.e. dominating function
statement: Let g, h : R -> R and let a, s, t be real numbers. Suppose that h is Lebesgue integrable on the open interval (-a, a), that s and t lie in the closed interval [-a, a], and that g is interval integrable between s and t, i.e. integrable on uIoc s t = (min s t, max s t]. Suppose also that for Lebesgue-almost every r, -a < r < a implies |g(r)| <= h(r). Then the oriented interval integral ∫_s^t g(r) dr is at most the Bochner integral ∫_{(-a,a)} h(r) dr for Lebesgue measure on (-a, a).
